prompt: Gold sells hot soup on a cold day
title: Hot Soup Day
irony: Gold charges extra for every warm sip so his hot soup sits untouched and cold, until one free bowl brings the whole street back warm.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Icy wind rattles the street while Gold's diner window glows with a big steaming soup pot.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green and Navy hurry toward the diner for hot soup, but Green recites soup facts and fears a too-hot sip.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Purple drums up a chilly crowd with frosty truck treats while Gold's pricey soup sits untouched.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Everyone gathers chanting for hot soup as steam swirls above Gold's counter.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Gold charges extra for cups and spoons, so Green overchecks the heat and Navy spills a sip.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Silver slips on ice at the door, his delivery topples, and the soup line dissolves into chilly giggles.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The crowd chants for hot soup again, stamping cold feet while Gold guards his pot.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold watches empty stools and feels his cold coins cannot warm his own hands.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold sees Navy share his scarf with Silver and decides a free bowl warms more than coins.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Gold ladles a free bowl for shivering Silver as all chant, turning the last line to giving warmth.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: All share free soup together while the same icy wind outside now feels cozy past glowing windows.
